properties.name: vincent.dict.enabled
properties.description: Enable Vincent Dict query auto-configuration and schema validation.

properties.name: vincent.dict.data-source-bean-name
properties.description: Optional host DataSource bean name. Must be set together with the SqlSessionFactory and transaction manager names.

properties.name: vincent.dict.sql-session-factory-bean-name
properties.description: Optional host SqlSessionFactory bean name. Must be set together with the DataSource and transaction manager names.

properties.name: vincent.dict.transaction-manager-bean-name
properties.description: Optional host PlatformTransactionManager bean name. Must be set together with the DataSource and SqlSessionFactory names.

properties.name: vincent.dict.admin.enabled
properties.description: Enable the embedded admin UI and API when the host is a Servlet web application and provides OperatorProvider plus PermissionProvider.

properties.name: vincent.dict.limits.default-items-per-dict
properties.description: Maximum default items allowed per dictionary.

properties.name: vincent.dict.limits.tenant-items-per-dict
properties.description: Maximum tenant items allowed per dictionary.

properties.name: vincent.dict.limits.max-effective-items
properties.description: Maximum effective items returned by a query. Must be >= default-items-per-dict + tenant-items-per-dict.

properties.name: vincent.dict.limits.max-page-size
properties.description: Maximum admin page size. Must be >= default-page-size.
